source.description: Solo violin vibrato bow sustains (p/f, no round robin) and spiccato (two velocities, two real round robins). Natural sampled bowing, not recorded legato transitions; not a string section.

channels: Original channels retained; no synthesized stereo
recordedRoundRobin: Sustain: one recording per pitch/velocity. Short: two independently recorded takes.
